run_call_and_extract_submodel: run call_and_extract_submodel to capture a selected sublayer's inputs, outputs, and state from a larger model
create_IsolatedSubmodel: create an IsolatedSubmodel instance with frozen parameters, saved arguments, and captured variable values for deterministic replay
test_IsolationCapturer: test the IsolationCapturer layer that wraps a submodel and captures its calls with saved inputs and outputs
summarize_IsolatedSubmodel: summarize the IsolatedSubmodel dataclass that stores a sublayer with saved args, side inputs, outputs, and variable values
review_call_and_extract_submodel: review call_and_extract_submodel which isolates a single pz.nn.Layer from a larger model and captures its activations and state
